A black-iron fortress at deep distance, every wall sheathed in riveted iron plating bolted over older stone, no windows visible at any level, a single gate-arch sealed with welded iron bars.

A demon-prince's throne citadel at deep distance, a dense vertical mass of black towers clustered around a single massive central keep, the skyline jagged and irregular as broken bone, entirely unlit.

A ruined war-cathedral at midground, its facade pocked by siege damage and scorched by old fire, the central rose window collapsed inward, the arched doorway framing only rubble and interior darkness.

A cursed gallows-keep at midground, a squat fortified structure bristling with extended iron gallows arms from every parapet, dozens of iron cages hanging at varying heights, several still containing skeletal remains.
